text: 4. Brigitte We met at university. We didn't have much to do with each other at first. We're a bit different. I'm quite quiet and, as you know, he's very outgoing. It's not that we didn't get on at all. We'd see each other in class and in the library and we'd chat a bit. Over time though, our chats got longer and then just before we left university he asked me out on a date. We've been seeing each other for about two years now. It's a shame it took so long for us to get together really.
